identity.title: DEBATE: Does God Exist? Dan Barker vs. Adam Lloyd Johnson
identity.dateBasis: Original video description explicitly dates the FREEFLO debate March 5, 2022 in Orlando; channel publisher event listing corroborates the event date. Upload date is March 25, 2022.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Speaker introductions, named handoffs and six uninterrupted formal speeches. No formal cross-examination or within-speech speaker switching.

acquisition.method: YouTube public Innertube Android player captions; srv3 XML normalized locally

content.coverageNote: Complete English captions span the full recording. Final applause caption lingers about 1.8 seconds beyond nominal video duration. Two gaps above twelve seconds occur during pre-opening setup and a rebuttal handoff. Both formal openings, both rebuttals, and both complete closings are present.
content.captionCaution: Automatic captions corrupt some names, negations and probability wording. Audio acquisition was denied; explicit source restrictions prevent rating or quote reliance on uncertain clauses.

participants.substantiveAdvocatesInOriginal: Two formal debaters, audience questions and surrounding host/debater conversation
participants.controllerExcludedMaterialReview: Controller read all 2651 canonical events, including the entire Q&A and surrounding host conversation, to establish boundaries and dependent-reply exclusions. Truncated initial read gaps were explicitly reread.

editorApprovedScope.userApproval: The user supplied this next video under the same invoked addition skill after instructing “Assess only the formal debates and closings.” This continuing scope is applied to this recording; no new user reply or automatic moderator exception is claimed.
editorApprovedScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: This assessment covers both formal opening statements and rebuttals (approximately 10:28–1:03:56), plus both closing statements (1:22:28–1:30:03). The entire audience Q&A, including both speakers’ answers and dependent replies, and the hosts’ introductory and concluding discussion are excluded at the editor’s request. Neither speaker receives credit or penalty for excluded material. These scores assess the formal rounds and closings, not the complete recording.

excludedIntervals.reason: Exclude the entire audience-question segment and transition, every audience intervention, both primary speakers’ answers and dependent replies. Resume at Barker’s independently introduced formal closing. The mixed preclosing event 2273 remains excluded in full.

editorApprovedScope.boundaryBasis: Retained substantive speech: Johnson opening events 299–675; Barker opening 688–1131; Barker rebuttal 1179–1486; Johnson rebuttal 1491–1743; Barker closing 2274–2380; Johnson closing 2382–2476. Intervening logistics and applause are unscored. The complete Q&A, including mixed event 2273, is excluded. Absolute caption times overlap at some handoffs, but no selected span may intersect the excluded interval.
editorApprovedScope.outsideWindowDisposition: Host introduction, speaker introductions and logistics before event 299, and applause plus host and debater concluding conversation after event 2476, are outside the assessed envelope and unscored.
editorApprovedScope.coherenceReview: Both openings, both rebuttals and both complete closings are retained. Closings may be assessed on their independently restated arguments and retained formal evidence only. No Q&A evidence, reply credit, concession or missing-response penalty may be imported. There is no formal cross-examination segment.

participants.questionHandling: Entire audience-question period and every answer/dependent reply excluded. Formal timing, thanks and applause unscored.
